sql.if: AND (CASE WHEN s.status = 'ACTIVE' AND s.expire_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP THEN 'EXPIRED' ELSE s.status END) = #{query.status}

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_sso_session s JOIN sys_application a ON a.id = s.application_id JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = s.user_id AND u.tenant_id = s.tenant_id WHERE s.is_delete = 0

SELECT s.session_id, s.parent_session_id, s.tenant_id, s.application_id, s.tenant_application_id, s.user_id, s.auth_time, s.expire_at, s.revoked_at, s.revoke_reason, a.name AS application_name, u.username, CASE WHEN s.status = 'ACTIVE' AND s.expire_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP THEN 'EXPIRED' ELSE s.status END AS status FROM sys_sso_session s JOIN sys_application a ON a.id = s.application_id JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = s.user_id AND u.tenant_id = s.tenant_id WHERE s.is_delete = 0 ORDER BY s.auth_time DESC, s.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
